subject: Eutopia procurement & onboarding clarifications
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Ng <c.ng@eutopia.health>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@eutopia.health>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 May 2028 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Eutopia procurement & onboarding clarifications

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation. Quick recap and a few asks so we can get Procurement and Finance moving on Redwood Dedicated for the pilot.

TL;DR next steps (can we confirm by end of week?):
- Procurement contact + required vendor intake form (we can fill what we have).
- Billing entity + PO cadence (monthly vs. annual) and invoice email.
- Any special contract clauses (data residency, indemnity caps, security addenda).
- Economic buyer / final approver name and timeline for signature.

Notes from the call:
- Use case: clinical summarization at scale (low-latency inference within VPC).
- Decision criteria: latency (p95 under 200ms), SOC2 Type II evidence, and predictable committed throughput.
- Economic buyer: Serena Kwan (VP, Data & AI) — Claire flagged Serena will want a short ROI breakdown.

Claire / Tom — could you: 1) share the procurement intake form (or tell us who to send it to), 2) confirm the billing/legal entity exactly as it should appear on an invoice, and 3) share any insurance/contract thresholds we should expect?

I'll get Monica to prep a short SOW + estimate (attached draft) and Naomi will pull our SOC2 and pen test artifacts.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 15m procurement kickoff if that helps.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0199

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_template_v1.docx (attached as draft)

From: Claire Ng <c.ng@eutopia.health>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@eutopia.health>
Date: Wed, 15 May 2028 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Eutopia procurement & onboarding clarifications

Hi Marcus / Monica — thanks for the recap.

Couple quick answers:
1) Procurement intake: attached is our standard vendor intake (Eutopia_vendor-intake.xlsx). Please fill and return to procure@eutopia.health.
2) Billing/legal entity: "Eutopia Health, Inc." — invoices should be addressed to: Eutopia Health, Inc.; AP: accounts.payable@eutopia.health; Tax ID: 12-3456789.
3) PO cadence: We prefer annual POs for pilots longer than 3 months, but Finance can do monthly for short pilots. If you can price both options that will speed approval.
4) Contract thresholds: For vendors handling clinical metadata we need $2M CGL and cyber liability; Serena will flag other clauses but typical caps are fine.

Serena is in Europe until 5/22 and will be back 5/23. She will review the ROI bullets (Claire) and legal will require our standard DPA + SOC2 attestation. Naomi — I'll take your SOC2 pack and share any gaps we see.

I've attached the intake and a short checklist — putting procure@eutopia.health on copy so they see the thread.

Best,
Claire Ng
Manager, Clinical Data Integrations
Eutopia Health
c.ng@eutopia.health

Attachments: Eutopia_vendor-intake.xlsx (form), Eutopia_procurement-checklist.pdf (1 page)

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 15 May 2028 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Eutopia procurement & onboarding clarifications

Forwarding Claire's intake — action items for us:
- Naomi: gather SOC2 Type II report, latest penetration test summary, and our DPA redline template. Put into the Drive folder and share link to Claire.
- Marcus: prepare two pricing rows in the SOW (monthly pilot 3 months, annual commit 12 months) and include committed throughput (tokens/min) and p95 latency targets.
- I'll draft a short SOW that lists Redwood Dedicated pool size and support SLA (SLA: 99.9% uptime, 100ms median inference).

Also confirm who signs on our side — legal prefers single-signatory for contracts under $250k; if Eutopia expects multiple approvers we should note that in the timeline.

I'll attach the SOW draft once I finish.

Thanks — Monica
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: (none in this message)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 16 May 2028 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Eutopia procurement & onboarding clarifications

Perfect, thanks Claire — that's super helpful. Quick checklist and proposed timeline: 
- Today: Eutopia_vendor-intake.xlsx returned to procure@eutopia.health (Claire) — Marcus will attach the filled copy.
- 5/17: Redwood to send SOW + two pricing options (Marcus & Monica).
- 5/23: Serena returns — target internal review complete by 5/27.
- 5/28: Procurement + Legal signoff target (DocuSign link to follow).

Open items for your procurement team: preferred PO frequency (confirm monthly vs annual), any required vendor security attestations beyond SOC2, and whether Eutopia requires an AUP or business associate agreement.

I've attached our draft SOW and a pricing sheet for the two cadence options. Naomi — I'll include the Drive link for SOC2 + pentest in case they need it.

Would you be available for a 20-minute procurement kickoff on 5/18 or 5/19? If you prefer a calendar invite, I can send one after you confirm a slot.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
